title: al-Battani: Opus Astronomicum / Kitab al-Zij, Text Working Edition and Audited Table Data
version: 2026-06-04 work-level package refresh: structurally complete text working edition, fixed-star catalogue data, geography gazetteer data, partial chronology, source witnesses, and workflow notes
description:
Work-level record for al-Battānī's Opus Astronomicum / Kitāb al-Zīj. Earlier versions of this same Zenodo concept foregrounded the fixed-star catalogue; this version gathers the al-Battānī work package in one place without creating a second DOI for the same work.

The front-facing reader is the 251-page text working edition: the 100 body-text segments are represented as Arabic source with English and Chinese translations and current catalogue, geography, and chronology layers appended. It is useful as a readable working edition, but it is not a final scholarly critical edition with every table placed back into its historical chapter location. The text should continue to be audited against Nallino as the edition is refined.

The reliable current table/data layers include the fixed-star catalogue data layer, the geographical gazetteer data layer, and the partial chronology / Canon of Kings layer. The Nallino source witness, Nallino Pars I-III table witness, canonical v083 TeX/data/report package, table reference supplement, source-data/workflow package, and compact latest-notes package are included for checking and provenance.

Table status is stated explicitly. The fixed-star catalogue is structurally complete at the current working-data level: 485 numbered star rows across 47 Ptolemaic figures, with ecliptic longitude and latitude values, north/south signs, magnitudes, modern identification fields, and the documented Escorial-codex lacuna shown in place. The geography gazetteer has 269 locality entries. The chronology layer is useful but partial; ancient regnal-year figures remain flagged for collation. Zodiac / terms / houses auxiliary tables are not cleanly tabulated in Nallino's Latin volume and are not fabricated here. Legacy filenames containing Complete Critical Edition are inherited labels and are not maintainer-certified critical-edition claims.

This record belongs to the broader non-European mathematics manuscript corpus, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20410957, and the main raw/provenance backstop, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Structurally complete text working edition plus fixed-star catalogue data and geography gazetteer data. The catalogue has 485 numbered star rows with longitude, latitude, N/S sign, magnitude, modern identifications, and Arabic/English descriptions for every row; the documented source lacuna is shown explicitly rather than silently filled. The 251-page trilingual text reader and catalogue files are not claimed as final scholarly critical editions.
